mapper.select: select m.id, m.name, m.gradeNo, g.gradeName from member m, grade g where (m.id = #{id} and m.pw = #{pw}) and (m.gradeNo = g.gradeNo)
select id from member where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into member(id, pw, name, gender, birth, tel, email) values(#{id}, #{pw}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birth}, #{tel}, #{email})
